name: openclaw-token-cost-guard
summary: Realtime OpenClaw token cost monitor with threshold-based alert reports.
description: Monitor OpenClaw agent session token usage, price DeepSeek/Kimi/GPT model calls, compare current cost against the previous snapshot, and generate or send an alert when spend exceeds a configured threshold.

scripts.description: Stdlib-only CLI for computing OpenClaw token costs and alerting on cost deltas.

author: openclaw
